err.weakPassword: The password must have at least 8 characters.
err.invalidUsername: Invalid username. Use 2–64 letters, digits or . _ - @
err.vaultNameTaken: A vault with this name already exists.
col.name: Name
field.usernameHint: Username: letters without accents, digits and . _ - @
setup.heading: Welcome to SimpleSync
setup.intro: The server is running. One step left: create the administrator account. You will use it to log in from Obsidian too.
dashboard.step1b: (or create it straight from Obsidian with “Create a new vault from this one”).
dashboard.step2: Install the SimpleSync plugin in Obsidian.
dashboard.step3: In the plugin, enter the server address, your name and password, and pick the vault.
dashboard.noVaults: You don't have access to any vault yet. Ask an administrator, or create a vault from Obsidian.
backup.zip: Also save every backup as a standalone ZIP file (in the server's backup folder – handy for copying to another disk)
backup.hint: A backup is only made when the vault changed since the last one. The newest backup is never deleted.
newVault.accessHint: Selected users become owners of the vault. You can add more members and roles later in the Members tab.
files.empty: The vault is empty. Connect it in Obsidian with the SimpleSync plugin.
file.noPreview: No preview available – download the file.
file.historyHint: Old versions are kept according to the server settings; full vault snapshots are in the Backups tab.
trash.hint: Deleted files. Open a file and restore its last version – the restore reaches all devices automatically.
backups.restoreConfirm: Restore the whole vault to the state of this backup? Files added later will be deleted (the current state is saved as a backup first).
members.none: The vault has no members yet (administrators always have access).
members.rolesHint: Owner manages members, backups and settings. Editor = full sync. Read only = the vault is downloaded but changes are not sent to the server.
vaultSettings.deleteHint: Deletes the vault from the server including history and all backups. Files on devices stay, they just stop syncing. This cannot be undone.
users.deleteConfirm: Delete user %s? Their devices will be logged out.
users.adminHint: Administrator (manages the server, sees all vaults)
devices.hint: Every login from the Obsidian plugin is one device. Logging a device out removes its access immediately.
settings.versionRetention: Keep the version history of files for (days, 0 = forever)
settings.usersCanCreate: Regular users can create new vaults from Obsidian
settings.defaultsHint: Vaults created from Obsidian get the default backup plan (daily, keep 30 days) – change it in the vault settings.
plugin.title: Connecting Obsidian
plugin.unzip: Unzip the ZIP into the folder (an “simplesync” folder appears):
plugin.enable: In Obsidian open Settings → Community plugins, turn off restricted mode and enable SimpleSync.
plugin.brat: On a phone it's easiest to use the BRAT plugin with the repository
plugin.notBundled: This server build doesn't include the plugin files. Download them from GitHub Releases of
plugin.fillIn: In the SimpleSync plugin settings fill in:
plugin.finish: Click Log in, pick a vault from the list and click Connect. Done.
msg.setupDone: The server is ready. Create your first vault.
msg.rateLimited: Too many attempts, try again in 15 minutes.
msg.currentPasswordWrong: The current password is not correct.
msg.passwordChanged: Password changed. Connected devices stay logged in.
msg.userCreated: User %s was created. Add them to a vault in the Members tab.
msg.lastAdmin: At least one administrator must remain.
msg.deviceLoggedOut: Device %s was logged out. It will be asked to log in on its next sync.
msg.backupFileNotFound: File not found in the backup.
msg.vaultRestored: The vault was restored to the state of %s (%d changes). The previous state was saved as a “Before restore” backup.
msg.pickBackupPolicy: Pick the backup frequency and how long to keep backups.
msg.vaultCreated: Vault %s was created. Pick it in Obsidian in the SimpleSync plugin settings.
msg.fileNotFound: File not found (its history may have been removed by the retention setting).
msg.caseConflict: The folder already contains %s, which differs only in letter case.
msg.versionRestored: The version from %s was restored and is syncing to your devices.
msg.memberAdded: %s now has access to the vault.
msg.confirmVaultName: To delete, type the exact vault name.
msg.csrf: Invalid form (CSRF). Reload the page and try again.
msg.adminOnly: This page is for administrators only.
msg.vaultNotFound: The vault doesn't exist or you have no access to it.
msg.forbidden: You don't have permission for this action.
obsidian.downloadHint: A ZIP with this vault's notes and the SimpleSync plugin already set up. Unzip it, in Obsidian choose “Open folder as vault”, click “Trust author and enable plugins” and enter your password.
plugin.easyTitle: The easy way: a ready-made vault
plugin.easyDesc: Download an Obsidian vault with the SimpleSync plugin already installed and set up for this server.
plugin.easyStep1: Unzip the file, for example into Documents.
plugin.easyStep2: In Obsidian choose “Open folder as vault” and pick the unzipped folder.
plugin.easyStep4: Enter your password in the window that appears and pick a vault. Done.
plugin.easyVaults: You can also download a vault including its notes: use “Download for Obsidian” in the vault list.
plugin.manualTitle: Advanced: install the plugin into an existing vault or on a phone
editor.name: Note name
editor.deleteConfirm: Delete “%s”? It goes to the vault's trash, where you can restore it.
editor.deleteFolderConfirm: Delete the folder “%s” and everything in it? The files go to the vault's trash.
editor.offline: Offline – will save when the server is back
editor.sessionExpired: You were logged out. Reload the page and log in again.
editor.merged: This note was also changed on another device. Both changes were combined.
editor.conflictCopy: This note was changed elsewhere at the same place. The other version is shown; yours was saved as “%s”.
editor.changedElsewhere: Updated with changes from another device.
editor.deletedElsewhere: This note was deleted on another device. Keep typing to restore it.
editor.exists: A file with that name already exists.
editor.invalidName: That name can't be used. Avoid \ : * ? " < > | and names starting with a dot.
editor.caseConflict: A file differing only in letter case already exists: %s
editor.binary: This file can't be edited here.
editor.emptyHint: Choose a note on the left, or start a new one. Changes are saved automatically and appear in Obsidian within seconds.
publish.title: Publishing
publish.intro: Turn chosen notes into a public website. Anyone with the address can read them, without logging in. Links between published notes work; everything else stays private.
publish.enable: Publish this vault as a website
publish.modeMarkedHint: Notes with “publish: true” in their properties. Use the Publish button in the editor.
publish.modeFolderHint: Every note in the folder below. Leave it empty for the whole vault.
public.notFoundHint: This page doesn't exist or isn't published.
err.invalidSlug: Use 3–50 lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
err.slugTaken: That address is already used by another vault.
agents.hint: Give an AI agent (Claude, ChatGPT, a script) access to your notes over MCP, without a local folder. It can read, search and, if you allow it, write notes; changes sync to all devices and stay in the file history. An agent never gets more than your own access.
agents.newTokenHint: Copy it now and paste it into your agent's settings. It is shown only this once.
agents.claudeSteps: Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector, paste the address above and click Connect. Claude opens this server's login page, where you choose the vault and whether it may write. No token needed. The server must be reachable from the internet over https.
agents.otherSteps: create a token below and send it in the header Authorization: Bearer <token>. For example:
agents.readWriteHint: Also create, edit, move and delete notes (where you can edit).
agents.revokeConfirm: Revoke access for %s? The agent stops working immediately.
agents.namePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Code on my laptop
oauth.heading: Allow %s to access your notes?
oauth.hint: After you allow it, you return to %s. The agent works as %s and you can revoke its access on the AI agents page at any time.
oauth.badRequest: This sign-in link is invalid or the app is no longer registered. Start connecting again from the app.
